title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Tenure Bonus on Everyday Pay Card Exit Settlements
content:
**Shopper Payout Plan Terms — tenure recognition at card exit.**

1. When a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account moves off the Everyday Pay Card plans, a tenure bonus is added for long-standing shoppers: a shopper whose contractor account was first activated 36 or more whole months ago has the shared amount raised by 10 percent, one activated 12 to 35 whole months ago has it raised by 5 percent, and any other shopper gets no bonus.
2. The date read is the first activation date on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record, counted in whole months to the day of the move.
3. The shared amount is the settlement sum (the capped statement month together with the older unpaid cashback) after the share of it that is paid has been applied. The bonus multiplies that amount by one plus the bonus rate (1.10 for 10 percent, 1.05 for 5 percent), and the settlement is rounded to the cent only on that final figure.

| Whole months since first activation | Bonus rate |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.10 (10 percent) |
| 12 to 35 | 0.05 (5 percent) |
| 11 or fewer | no bonus |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical inputs, shared amount 23.45).**
- First activated exactly 36 whole months before the move: 23.45 multiplied by 1.10 is 25.795, rounded to the cent 25.80.
- First activated 35 whole months before: 23.45 multiplied by 1.05 is 24.6225, rounded to the cent 24.62.
- First activated exactly 12 whole months before: 24.62, as in the line above.
- First activated 11 whole months before: no bonus, 23.45.
